payload.deliveryContract: Continue the implementation and review loop until every required CI check is terminal and passing, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts are resolved, and the PR is merged. Only then may Factory work complete. Opening a PR, making it review-ready, or obtaining green CI without merge is not completion. Shared-file churn is not an admission blocker; rebase and reconcile shared files as part of this delivery loop.
payload.requestedOutcome: Implement IMP-PROV-06 by migrating Agy live execution — including PTY allocation, executable discovery, terminal lifecycle, decoding, final selection, session metadata, and failure handling — into a parent-private Providers Execution adapter bound through the accepted catalog-backed execution registry. Preserve observable Agy request, PTY, stream/final-result where applicable, cancellation, timeout, diagnostics, failure, and detached Provider Session reference behavior. Remove only aggregate legacy Agy branches superseded by the cutover (including executeAgy / construction). Do not admit LWR-PROV, Workers fold/DEL, Automations/Recordings/PSES wire folds, OpenAPI fan-in, or PSS-I03. Explicitly loop through implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete the Factory work.
